title: Egg omelet or scrambled egg with cheese, meat, tomatoes, and dark‑green vegetables, fat added

content.title: About
content.content: This dish consists of eggs prepared as an omelet or scrambled, combined with cheese, meat, tomatoes, and dark‑green vegetables (such as spinach or broccoli). An additional source of fat (butter, cream, or oil) is included to increase the energy content.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Eggs are a complete protein source, containing all essential amino acids.
Cheese adds calcium and richness, while also increasing fat and calorie levels.
Meat (ham, bacon, or chicken) boosts iron and vitamin B12 content.
Dark‑green vegetables are rich in B‑vitamins, vitamin K, and antioxidants.
Added fat improves absorption of fat‑soluble vitamins A, D, E, and K.

items.title: High‑quality protein
items.content: Eggs and meat provide complete protein essential for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Bone support
items.content: Cheese and green vegetables supply calcium and vitamin K, which help maintain strong bones.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Tomatoes and green vegetables contain lycopene, lutein, and other antioxidants that protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Energy density
items.content: The added fat raises the calorie content, useful for individuals with higher energy needs.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamins A and D found in eggs and fat contribute to normal immune system function.

items.title: Egg or dairy allergy
items.content: Some people may experience allergic reactions to eggs, cheese, or dairy fat.

items.title: High saturated fat content
items.content: Large amounts of butter or fatty meat can raise cholesterol levels if consumed frequently.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Cheese and processed meat often contain salt; individuals with hypertension should monitor portions.

items.title: Caloric load
items.content: The dish is relatively calorie‑dense (approximately 500‑600 kcal per serving), so it should be balanced within the overall diet.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Beat eggs with a splash of milk or cream, stir in grated cheese, diced meat, tomatoes, and green vegetables. Heat oil or butter in a skillet, pour the egg mixture, and cook to the desired consistency, stirring occasionally.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Best enjoyed fresh. If needed, store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours. Reheat in a skillet or microwave before serving.
